title: Repeated IAM/PAM Action Execution
id: d5c9f6e2-3b9a-4f12-9c1e-7d2a5e4b6f8a
status: test
description: Detects replay or duplicate execution of privileged IAM/PAM actions within a short time window, indicating possible abuse.
author: SOC Team
date: 2026-09-30
logsource:
  product: iam
  service: pam
detection:
  selection:
    event_type: "IAM_PAM_ACTION"
  timeframe: 24h
  repeated_action:
    - action_id: "*"
  condition: selection and repeated_action
fields:
  - action_id
  - username
  - timestamp
  - initiator
level: high
